manifest.name: sequence-send
manifest.description: One fired step of one enrollment (BO-F3-03): the evidence a step was queued into the channels outbox under its deterministic key, is waiting for a human approval, was confirmed sent, or died there. Metrics count these rows, never stored counters, so a crash or a retry cannot drift them. (backlog:22bb154a72ea)

migrations.name: create_sequence_sends
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sequence_sends (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  enrollment_source_key TEXT,
  sequence_source_key TEXT,
  space_id TEXT,
  step_order INTEGER,
  message_key TEXT,
  job_id TEXT,
  variables TEXT,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('queued', 'waiting-approval', 'sent', 'dead-letter', 'skipped')),
  queued_at TEXT,
  decided_at TEXT,
  detail TEXT,
  actor_type TEXT CHECK(actor_type IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sequence_sends_enrollment_source_key ON sequence_sends(enrollment_source_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sequence_sends_sequence_source_key ON sequence_sends(sequence_source_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sequence_sends_space_id ON sequence_sends(space_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sequence_sends_status ON sequence_sends(status);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_sequence_sends
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."sequence_sends" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "enrollment_source_key" TEXT,
  "sequence_source_key" TEXT,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "step_order" BIGINT,
  "message_key" TEXT,
  "job_id" TEXT,
  "variables" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('queued', 'waiting-approval', 'sent', 'dead-letter', 'skipped')),
  "queued_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "decided_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "detail" TEXT,
  "actor_type" TEXT CHECK("actor_type" IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  "actor_id" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "sequence_sends_enrollment_source_key"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_sends"("enrollment_source_key");

CREATE INDEX "sequence_sends_sequence_source_key"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_sends"("sequence_source_key");

CREATE INDEX "sequence_sends_space_id"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_sends"("space_id");

CREATE INDEX "sequence_sends_status"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_sends"("status");
